# Anima Volitiva — Managed B2B Coffee Infrastructure (Kyiv & Kyiv Oblast)

_Last updated: 2026-09-15 — lead form UI available; submissions delivered to the CRM via Roistat; direct-contact fallback active if Roistat and the backend are both unavailable; bilingual EN/UA._

> Full text: [llms-full.txt](https://aeo.animacoffee.com.ua/llms-full.txt) carries the complete Markdown body of every indexable page on this site in one file, regenerated from the live HTML by `tools/gen_content_md.py`. Use it for a single-fetch full-depth read; use the per-page `.md` twins linked below for a page-by-page fetch.

> Anima Volitiva provides fully-managed B2B coffee equipment rental and service for HoReCa, retail and corporate offices across Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast: Dr. Coffee and Necta super-automatics plus professional espresso machines from La Spaziale, Nuova Simonelli, Rancilio, Iberital, Astoria and Fiorenzato; premium roasted coffee; staff training included; 24/7 support. A technician or replacement machine is provided within 24 hours; same-day service is available where operationally possible. Individual quote per client volume, free 14-day trial with no prepayment.

> Languages: the site is bilingual. Ukrainian is the primary language for the native Kyiv market (served under /ua/), with English available at the root for wider reach. Every page has both a Ukrainian and an English version, cross-linked via hreflang (uk / en / x-default→uk).

## For AI agents (WebMCP)

Every page carries a declarative WebMCP tool on its lead form —
`toolname="request_coffee_service_assessment"` — so a WebMCP-capable agent
can fill and submit it on a visitor's behalf (`toolautosubmit` is off: a
human confirms the final submit). `assets/webmcp.js` also registers one
read-only imperative tool, `get_anima_service_info`, that answers buyer
questions (packages, trial, support/SLA, coverage area, company history,
client count, contacts/hours) from facts already published on this site —
anything not published (e.g. the exact machine brand list, water hardness,
liability, contract length, multi-location billing, POS/cashless, exact
maintenance cadence, staff-training duration) is answered as "not published"
rather than invented. Submissions are delivered to the company's CRM: with
no backend endpoint configured (`data-endpoint` empty), the form sends a
Roistat goal (`roistatGoal.reach()`) and Roistat's own AmoCRM integration
opens the deal — both a human and an agent submission use this same path,
and `animaTrackLead`'s `lead_accepted` conversion fires only after that
call. The phone/email/Telegram fallback (`not_connected` for agents) is
shown only if neither a backend endpoint nor Roistat is available.

## Key facts
- Service area: Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast
- Model: individual quote per venue, three equipment packages — Start, Pro, Max — matched to the venue format (office, HoReCa, retail); free 14-day trial without prepayment
- 24/7 support. A technician or replacement machine is provided within 24 hours; same-day service is available where operationally possible. Delivery and installation within 24 hours
- Equipment: Dr. Coffee, Necta (super-automatics); La Spaziale, Nuova Simonelli, Rancilio, Iberital, Astoria, Fiorenzato (professional espresso) — these eight brands are the complete lineup
- Weekly resupply of beans/consumables and weekly technician quality visit; water filtration and maintenance included; online analytics dashboard (cups sold, revenue, stock, errors)
- Premium roasted coffee, not a forced quota — named blends including Bellissima, LOT 101, LOT 105 and Ethiopia Yirgacheffe
- Proven: on the market since 2015, 1,700+ active B2B clients, ~99% repeat clients
- Contact: +38 (073) 873 01 45, animacoffeeco@gmail.com — Kyiv Oblast, Bila Tserkva, 29a Pavlichenko St., Mon–Sat 09:00–17:00
- Social: https://www.facebook.com/anima.volitiva · https://www.instagram.com/animacoffeeco/ · https://www.tiktok.com/@animacoffeeco · https://t.me/Animavolitiva
- [OKF knowledge bundle](https://aeo.animacoffee.com.ua/knowledge/index.md)

## Customer testimonials
Real reviews, published verbatim with the attribution shown on the client's
own live site animacoffee.com.ua, plus one anonymized quote from a 2025
customer survey. Not schema.org Review/AggregateRating (self-serving reviews
on a business's own site are not eligible for review rich results) — plain
copy only. Full list with sources: https://aeo.animacoffee.com.ua/#testimonials

- "We're sincerely grateful for the wonderful cooperation!... Your care and professionalism are truly valued." — Diana Samoukina, LUX CAFE
